definitions.explanation: The second month of the year and the shortest month. Features Setsubun (節分) and Valentine's Day.

examples.japanese: {二月|にがつ}は{短|みじか}いです。
{二月|にがつ}{十四日|じゅうよっか}はバレンタインデーです。
{二月|にがつ}に{雪|ゆき}がたくさん{降|ふ}ります。
examples.english: It snows a lot in February.

notes: February is literally 'month two.' In Japan, Valentine's Day is when women give chocolate to men, with White Day (March 14) for reciprocation. Setsubun (February 3) marks the end of winter.
